recap: Cavaliers lost to the Raptors 112–110 in overtime.
Evan Mobley led the Cavaliers with 26 points (9-15 FG, 3-7 3PT), 14 rebounds and 3 assists.
Scottie Barnes led the Raptors with 25 points (11-21 FG, 0-2 3PT), 7 rebounds and 14 assists.
CLE won 1 of 4 factors: second chances. Effective FG% 48.9 to 53.4.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Mitchell, Allen, Wade, Mobley, Harden, +7 in 13:16.
Bench points: CLE 24, TOR 30. Points in the paint: 54–48. Second-chance points: 24–12.
